title: A szolidaritási vagyonadóról (T/5575)
by: Tordai Bence, Berki Sándor, Mellár Tamás, Jámbor András, Szabó Rebeka, Szabó Tímea (Párbeszéd)
summary: Annual solidarity wealth tax on net wealth above HUF 600m at 1.7%, 2.1% and 3.5% bands.
status: On 6 November 2023 the Economic Committee refused to take it onto the agenda (T/5575/2)

title: A milliárdosok vagyonadójáról (T/12722)
summary: 1% annual tax on net wealth above HUF 1bn for Hungarian citizens, excluding the owner-occupied home.
status: On 2 December 2025 the Economic Committee refused to take it onto the agenda (T/12722/2)

title: A vagyonadóról (T/930)
by: Government of Hungary (rapporteur: András Kármán, Minister of Finance)
summary: 1% annual tax on net wealth above HUF 1bn and 1.5% above HUF 100bn; first valuation date 31 December 2026, first payment by 31 August 2027.
status: Submitted to the National Assembly on 27 October 2026; debate and vote not found as of 4 November 2026
